column1: # Census version 8: one line per entry of the archived table with 3<=d<=32, N<=1024 (make_numbers_v8.py).

# verdict: strict | local | nonstrict | notlocal (flat core) | equalcontact_notlocal (the proposal's equal-contact configuration is not a local minimum) | flex (no local minimum within delta, resolved) | unresolved (the negative certificate holds with delta < 1e-12 or delta set by h) | none

# certificate: how the verdict was obtained (strict_above, nonstrict_above, notlocal_flat_above: the exact route above the size limit, run_above.py or above_more.py; flex_unres: the negative certificate holds but is unresolved; flex_exact_fail: the census's negative certificate failed the exact test with every right inverse tried)

# c_lo_30, c_hi_30: the 30-digit decimal interval of the certified cosine (zero of the square system); dist_ls: certified least-squares distance to the stored code (non-rattlers; local minima: plus the tube); gap_lower: exact lower bound of the gap to the nearest non-contact pair of non-rattlers; gap_first_pass: the first pass's value of the gap to the nearest non-contact pair, rattlers included (double precision); tau_prime, h, delta: the negative certificate.
